findings.description: All 15 historical note groups form separate blocks at their source-page breaks. Retained malformed reference markers, superscript fragments, citation punctuation and the short stray glyph cluster remain visible, but do not fuse a note into body or cause sustained unreadability. Page 7 retains the conclusion, date, LEO PAPA XIII and final Psalm note. Apparatus begins at bottom left and continues at top right in normal column order on this same source-bearing page.

documents.limitations: Independent layout, selected source-boundary, replay and native OCR-PDF geometry acceptance. All reader pages contact- and full-size-inspected; native inspection is bounded to the exact pages listed in the report. No original-print collation, lexical OCR correction, translation accuracy, whole-book completeness or independent rights certification. No raster reuse.
